adds.title: Supreme Court of Russia ruling - November 2023 designating 'international LGBT public movement' as extremist
adds.summary: In November 2023 the Russian Supreme Court designated the 'international LGBT public movement' as extremist and banned it nationwide including Kabardino-Balkaria, making public LGBT-related expression, advocacy or display — including trans identity expression — punishable by fines, administrative detention and criminal imprisonment for participation in an extremist organisation.
